pr_body:
Now that we are moving into the development cycle for v24.1 on master, we should also keep up our dep rule directories. This commit duplicate `rule/current` into `rule/release_23_2` which stores all the dep-rules of the declarative schema changer for release v23.2.

Fixes #112571
Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/113010)

issue_context.title: scplan: create `scplan/internal/rules/release_23_2`
issue_context.body:
The declarative schema changer maintains dep-rule between releases by grouping all rules present in each release in a separate directory. Now that branch `release-23.2` is cut, we should create one for it on master. 

Note: It's currently not doable as cluster version `V24_1` does not exist yet on master

Jira issue: CRDB-32498
comments:
@Xiang-Gu the version should exist now, since https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/112271 was merged.

I believe resolving this issue should also resolve https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/112376.

review_comments: The `.` import of the `rules` package really threw me for a loop here. It might be worth considering removing in the future so changes like this don't seem broken? 😅

We did that to reduce verbosity in the rules ecosystem. When we split them into versions originally, we did try multiple things with helpers (i.e. each rule version has its own helper or helpers use full package names to access). We eventually settled on this.
